description: This file contains interfaces, classes, and static methods for message channels utilizing Azure Storage Queues. It defines message sending and receiving channels, implementations for sending and receiving messages, and methods for creating channels connected to Azure Queue services.

classes.name: SendChannel
classes.description: Implements the ISendChannel interface, manages sending messages to a write queue and receiving acknowledgments from a read queue.

classes.name: ReceiveChannel
classes.description: Implements the IReceiveChannel interface, manages waiting for messages and sending acknowledgments.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: A static class providing factory methods for creating send and receive channels with Azure Queue Storage.

methods.name: SendMessages
methods.description: Sends a list of messages to the write queue and waits for acknowledgment messages from the read queue.

methods.name: WaitForMessage
methods.description: Extension method that waits asynchronously for a message from the queue, deserializes it to the specified type, and deletes the message from the queue.

methods.name: CreateSendChannel
methods.description: Factory method to create an ISendChannel for a given cluster ID and Azure Queue URI or QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: CreateReceiveChannel
methods.description: Factory method to create an IReceiveChannel for a given server name, cluster ID, and Azure Queue URI or QueueServiceClient.
